title: improv·artist · collage (Wangechi Mutu)
mutation_directive: improv artist: collage via Wangechi Mutu

improv_extras.practice: ink and collage hybrids; mythic figures, Afrofuturist body

v1.feedback: The three-layer collage concept (ink body, gold leaf fragments, botanical tendrils) is a genuine Mutu-driven structural choice, not a relabel. However, the body-profile radial force at 0.004 is likely too gentle against the differential-growth dynamics — the figure will read as a vaguely shaped tower rather than a mythic standing body with clear hips/waist/shoulders. Double that force and add a stronger neck pinch to make the silhouette legible in 2s. The 6k gold-leaf particles scattered in a shell risk reading as ambient sparkle noise; cluster them into discrete rectangular 'fragment' patches at varying orientations to evoke actual collage cutouts rather than diffuse shimmer.

v2.feedback: The three-layer decomposition (ink-wash body, gold-leaf collage shards, botanical tendrils) maps genuinely to Mutu's mixed-media practice and the body-profile envelope is well-parameterized — the idea clearly drove the design. However, the differential-growth ring is a single closed loop, so the silhouette is fundamentally a modulated tube; the 0.008 radial force is likely too weak against repulsion+pressure to carve a readable hip-waist-shoulder differentiation in 2 seconds, risking a tapered column rather than a mythic figure. Double the body-profile force to ~0.016 and add a second pass that clamps outlier vertices hard to the envelope (e.g. lerp toward targetR when curR deviates >30%), and consider spawning two small satellite rings at shoulder height to hint at arms/wings — that would push the silhouette from 'organic tower' to 'standing figure' which is the whole point of the Mutu channel.
